site.name: Vesperthorn Atelier
site.heroTitle: Gothic jewellery forged in shadow and silver
site.heroText: Rings, pendants, chokers and crosses cast from blackened silver and set with blood-dark stones. Step inside and meet the pieces of our collection.
site.aboutText: In a candlelit workshop beneath the old abbey, each piece in our collection is sculpted in wax, cast in silver, and set by hand with garnet, onyx or moonstone. Ravens, bats, roses and thorns keep watch over every design. Visit our shop for polishing cloths, velvet caskets and other keepsakes of the night.
site.socialText: New pieces, workshop glimpses and candlelit behind-the-scenes. Follow us where the shadows gather.

pieces.name: Memento Mori Ring
pieces.description: A grinning skull crowns a heavy oxidised band. Two garnet-dark hollows watch the wearer, a reminder that every hour is borrowed.

pieces.name: Black Rose Ring
pieces.description: A fully opened rose with thorns climbing the shoulders of the band. Beautiful, and not quite safe to hold.

pieces.name: Perched Raven Pendant
pieces.description: A raven in profile, cast with ruffled feathers and a polished jet eye. It carries secrets and keeps them.

pieces.name: Nocturne Bat Pendant
pieces.description: Scalloped wings spread wide beneath a tiny ruby heart. Light as a whisper, dark as the sky it was made for.

pieces.name: Cathedral Cross
pieces.description: A flared gothic cross with a garnet set at its crossing, inspired by the stone tracery of a ruined nave.

pieces.name: Reliquary Cross
pieces.description: Trefoil terminals and a haloed moonstone at the heart. Made to be worn over the heart, or kept in a velvet casket.

pieces.name: Briar Thorn Choker
pieces.description: A ribbon of black velvet lined with silver thorns and a single obsidian teardrop at the throat.

pieces.name: Vesper Chain Choker
pieces.description: Hand-linked chain that falls into a drop of dark amethyst. Wear it with black lace and moonlight.

shop.name: Silver Polishing Cloth
shop.description: Soft, anti-tarnish cloth that keeps blackened silver glowing in the dark.

shop.name: Velvet Reliquary Casket
shop.description: Burgundy velvet casket with a silver clasp, made to keep one precious piece safe.

shop.name: Anti-Tarnish Pouch Set
shop.description: Three drawstring pouches in black cotton, lined to slow the creep of tarnish.

shop.name: Cathedral Display Stand
shop.description: Wrought-iron stand shaped like a pointed arch, for pendants and chokers.

shop.name: Black Wax Votive Candle
shop.description: Hand-poured votive in black wax, scented with incense, myrrh and old stone.

shop.name: Raven Quill & Ink Set
shop.description: Black feather quill, crimson ink and a sheet of aged paper for letters to the dead.

announcement.title: The Midnight Reliquary Opens
announcement.content:
Our newest collection of silver rings, pendants and chokers arrives with the long nights.

Visit the shop for limited editions, and ask us about a bespoke commission.

event.title: Meet the Jeweller at the Whitby Night Market
event.content: Try on rings and chokers by candlelight, watch a piece being set, and find the jewel that finds you.
